study.question: Does removing explicit current auxiliary targets from the orientation-bit source preserve the sign-dependent click-AUC advantage of the strongest true-label joint transfer, when the rest of auxiliary supervision remains fixed? Observed starting points: DIN 0.6555440824; original joint 0.6684573079 versus click-only/context-blocked 0.6678548721; r0069 full negative/positive 0.6689610676/0.6683760512 and label-reflected negative/positive 0.6688693285/0.6682470690. Mean-target negative/positive were nearly equal (r0067 0.6686874913/0.6686740459), while isolated label deviation favored the other sign (r0068 0.6683408024/0.6687193398). These same-seed trajectories motivate isolating the current prediction term; they do not establish a mechanism or seed robustness.
study.hypothesis: At fixed recipient computation the nonsaturated sigmoid+BCE logit coefficient is p-y. All-zero-target BCE supplies p without explicit current auxiliary targets. Hypothesis: this prediction-side source can retain a substantial part of the negative-versus-positive external-sign advantage seen with p-y. Mean-target cancellation and nonlinear global pivot extraction could explain why the mean-label source did not retain it. This is unverified; the alternative is that the true outcome term is necessary for the useful bit. Learned private heads, native true-label radius/support/line, historical actions and click labels remain, so even a positive result cannot show that auxiliary supervision as a whole is unnecessary.

Here the inherited manipulation is before shared-embedding scatter and its orientation is a batch pivot bit; isolate zero versus true source targets with fixed true-label native geometry. This is not PCGrad and no general gradient-surgery novelty is asserted.

study.proposed_difference: Replace only the auxiliary orientation-bit source objective: G_y=grad_context(sum auxiliary BCE(p,y)) versus G_0=grad_context(sum auxiliary BCE(p,0)), using actual probability BCE and the same recipient graph. Both BCE graphs are evaluated and differentiated with explicit (true,zero) weights (1,0) or (0,1). All-zero targets are constants created from probability shape, independent of supplied labels; include empty rows because training-time Dice can couple them to occupied rows. Native true-label cotangents still define geometry and private gradients. Cross source choice with external signs reversed/aligned in a four-cell matched design. No modules, parameters, persistent state, RNG, extra model forward, task weights or data policy change. Full-source bridges test the altered unused BCE graph path. Host preflight before full units: compare identically initialized fixed-state models on the same authorized batch; require exactly identical forward predictions, running-statistic updates and scalar true-label BCE across cells, finite backward and identical private gradients within FP32/BF16 arithmetic tolerance. Verify only shared-context cotangents vary. Use mixed/empty/single-occupied histories, all-empty and zero-cotangent degeneracies, tied pivots, saturated probabilities and finite gradients. Check masks and no current target action/label leakage. Conventional finite-difference gradcheck of the reported BCE is inapplicable to this declared surrogate VJP. At fixed detached cotangents compare source_bit_diagnostics for G_y and G_0: native-active bit disagreement, sign balance, source/native orthogonal norm ratios and pivot stability, pre/post-cast norms, zero support and K orthogonality before embedding-ID scatter. Row-space orthogonality does not establish parameter-space or optimizer-update orthogonality. The helper is callable but the documented host API does not automatically collect it; missing probes must be reported as missing and prevent a mechanism conclusion.
predictions: If prediction-side source suffices locally, zero_target_bit_negative exceeds zero_target_bit_positive in validation click AUC and retains much of the matched full-source gap. Predeclare a descriptive practical signal: gap at least 0.0003 and zero-negative within 0.00015 AUC of matched full-negative; these are resolution criteria, not significance tests or selection-based confidence intervals.
Full-source bridges reproduce r0069 same-sign AUC within 0.000001. Any larger drift blocks the causal interpretation of comparison to old trajectories pending implementation/numerical diagnosis.

At identical fixed state all forward values, true-label scalar BCE and private gradients match; only selected shared-context transfer orientation may differ. On native-active, nondegenerate inputs the same true radius/line/support hold. G_0 need not yield the same bit as G_y.
Parameter counts and inference computation remain inherited; host-measured training/validation costs should be close across all four arms, with no claimed efficiency gain before measurement.
falsifiers: After passing preflight and bridges, substantial source-bit disagreement accompanied by disappearance/reversal of the zero-source external-sign gap, or a zero-negative deficit greater than 0.00015 relative to full-negative, contradicts the proposed sufficiency at this seed. A gap below 0.0001 is descriptively absent at the prespecified resolution; intermediate outcomes are inconclusive.

An apparently preserved gap without measured bit disagreement does not distinguish prediction-side sufficiency from an ineffective intervention. Missing bit diagnostics leave the source mechanism unresolved.
Any changed forward/private gradients/geometry support, nonfinite loss/backward or bridge failure is an implementation/validity failure, not scientific evidence that auxiliary labels help or hurt.
Loss of the effect under future authorized paired seeds would invalidate a robust mechanism claim. Repeating seed 20262027 is replay, not independent support.
alternative_explanations: G_0 can still reflect auxiliary information through true-label-trained heads/Jacobians and shared state; native radius, support and fixed-angle construction also retain true labels. This study removes only explicit current auxiliary targets from one sign source.
Rare positive labels might not alter the maximal-coordinate pivot often; equal AUC could reflect nearly identical bits, not an effective replacement.
Batch-order dependence, pivot ties, BF16 casts, probability saturation/clamped BCE, sparse repeated-ID scatter and optimizer preconditioning can cause apparent geometric effects.

Training Dice couples examples, including empty-history rows; hence zero-source targets must be zero everywhere. The change deliberately removes empty-row labels too, and cannot localize an effect to occupied versus empty-row outcomes.
Extensive same-validation adaptive search and one fixed seed may explain small AUC differences. Existing deterministic bridges do not provide independent repetitions.

Row-space noninterference is neither a parameter-space guarantee nor a guarantee of later click generalization. Auxiliary benchmark labels match category/brand within 24h rather than direct ad conversions; official_offline visibility limits deployment interpretation.

cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve 6000 seconds for later authorized repetition/assessment. Current training seed and protocol remain frozen. cost_plan.stop_rule: Execute no training in propose phase. Host must charge all four cells, controls, preflight, failures and retries; stop at the global deadline, per-trial cap, integrity failure, or when an admissible complete unit plus required reserves no longer fits. Recheck actual remaining budget before dispatch. If bridges/preflight fail, stop attribution and diagnose without changing contracts. Never call training failure or exhausted budget scientific success.
